# qip

> qip is a small, deterministic host for composing WebAssembly modules over text, bytes, and images across CLI, browser, and web routing workflows.

qip favors explicit contracts and simple pipelines. Modules are sandboxed (no filesystem, no network, no environment access), and hosts compose them into predictable stage-by-stage processing.

## Core Docs

- [How qip works](/docs/how-it-works.md): End-to-end runtime model for modules, routing, and recipes.
- [Module contract](/docs/module-contract.md): Required exports, memory pointers, capacities, and host interaction rules.
- [Module patterns](/docs/module-patterns.md): Practical implementation patterns for qip modules.
- [Comply](/docs/comply.md): Compliance checks and ABI verification guidance.
- [Security model](/docs/security-model.md): Sandboxing boundaries and trust assumptions.

## Router & Site Building

- [Router](/docs/router.md): `qip router` and `qip dev` behavior, route resolution, and WARC flow.
- [Recipes](/docs/recipes.md): Recipe discovery/order and content-vs-WARC processing layers.
- [Content layout](/docs/content.md): Content root layout and path rules.
- [Formats and encodings](/docs/formats.md): Preferred content formats used throughout qip.
